integrity: The proof of the universal statement is analytical; the included Python tests examine finite instances. All novelty and value assessments are same-model only.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite-iteration norm is an explicit maximum over grid steps, not a proved universal central-step formula at every iteration. Eventual-central cutoff depends on degree and is not quantified; degree and iteration are not sent jointly to infinity. Historical unindexed equivalents cannot be ruled out.
title: Sharp \(BV\)-to-\(L^1\) mean-mixing for iterated Bernstein–Kantorovich operators
